vellum.$description: Vellum — Page background — the warm off-white that defines the entire canvas tone

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, elevated panels, product mockup backgrounds

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, heavy structural borders, nav bar outlines

carbon.$description: Carbon — Warm near-black for dark panels, footer background, and neutral filled button fill — the only filled button in the system

ash.$description: Ash — Light hairline borders, card outlines, subtle dividers

olive-char.$description: Olive Char — Mid-dark structural borders, heavier dividers between sections

lichen.$description: Lichen — Body text, secondary borders, muted paragraph copy

sage.$description: Sage — Nav link text, muted UI labels, breadcrumb text

moss.$description: Moss — Icon strokes and fills, tertiary text, decorative icon tint

bone.$description: Bone — Subtle warm tint surface for tag backgrounds, soft highlight washes

highlighter-yellow.$description: Highlighter Yellow — Single accent — decorative bars, highlight washes, emphasis marks. Appears 3–4 times per page maximum, always as a 4–6px stroke or small fill block

khaki-olive.$description: Khaki Olive — Muted accent for tag borders, secondary button outlines, warm-tinted surface washes — the restrained sibling of the highlighter

serif-custom-resembles-a-high-contrast-m.$value: Serif (custom — resembles a high-contrast modern editorial serif like Reckless Neue
serif-custom-resembles-a-high-contrast-m.$description: resembles a high-contrast modern editorial serif like Reckless Neue, GT Sectra, or PP Editorial New) — All display and heading copy. Used at poster sizes (64–96px) for hero headlines and product section titles. The weight 300 at 96px is the signature move — whisper-thin strokes at near-poster scale create authority through restraint, not volume. Tight tracking (-0.05em) at all sizes; line-heights under 1.1 let letterspacing do the vertical work

mono-custom-clean-geometric-monospace.$description: clean geometric monospace) — All UI text: navigation, buttons, labels, body copy, metadata, footer links. The mono choice is deliberate — it makes every UI element feel like terminal output or code annotation, contrasting the serif's editorial softness. Weight 400 dominates; 500 for button text; 300 reserved for large mono headings (28–48px range)
